# sendlnbroadcast

Broadcasts the data. *(version 4.62 or later)*

```ttl
sendlnbroadcast <data1> <data2>....
```

## Remarks

Causes Tera Term to broadcast characters followed by a new-line character to all terminals, and then the data is sent to the host.
Format of &lt;data&gt; is the same as the "[sendbroadcast](sendbroadcast.md)" command.

Sent data is ignored on the terminal the [AcceptBroadcast](https://teratermproject.github.io/manual/5/en/html/menu/setup-additional.html) is disabled.

## Example

```ttl
; Sends "ABCdefGHI" with a new-line character.
sendlnbroadcast "ABC" "def" "GHI"

; Only a new-line character is sent.
sendlnbroadcast
```
